title: Blade styles
lead: Edit config/blade_styles.ini. A blade style is a recipe: a base blade (color + extend/retract) plus separate overlay layers for smoke, clash, lockup, and other effects. Use solid for a composable base with no built-in combat. Presets pick the whole recipe: style = config smoke_blade.
help.recipe: Recipe — one [section] in this file; a stack of layer = lines composited bottom → top.
help.baseLayer: Base layer — solid, fire, rainbow, water_flow, … fills the blade when ignited.
help.variables: Variables — base = cyan + {{base}} in layers; presets override with style = config section base=red.
help.previewNotePrefix: Preview is approximate — verify on the saber. Full examples and build-from recipes:
hint.baseBlade: Color and extend/retract timing for the bottom opaque layer only. Clash, lockup, blast, and other effects are configured on their layers below. Standard color names work in presets; extended and vivid colors export as r,g,b. Custom #rrggbb is also supported.
hint.noBaseVars: No base variables — select the bottom layer to edit args directly.
hint.recipeStack: Click a layer to expand it inline (one at a time). Reorder with ↑↓ on each row (or inside the editor). Remove with the trash icon. Base color and in/out also live in Base blade when the bottom layer uses {{base}} / {{ext}} / {{ret}}.
hint.export: Changes update the Export page immediately. Preview approximates on-saber rendering.
